description.value: The Amelia Douglas Gallery is a public art gallery located on the third floor of Douglas College, showcasing works by emerging and established artists with a focus on contemporary practice. Named after a historical figure significant to British Columbia, it serves as a cultural hub within the college community. Touring cyclists stopping in the area can visit for free cultural programming alongside other campus amenities.
